messages:
maria nguyen: heads up — handbook microguide image 404 on /handbook/onboarding/quickstart (screenshot). Who owns this page? small PR would fix it.
docs-bot: link-scanner detected 404 at https://assets.redwood.com/handbook/onboarding/quickstart/qs-screenshot.png — scan id: 1767123456
devon: I'll grab it, can someone rehost the image to our CDN? I don't have upload perms for assets bucket.
maria nguyen: path: docs/content/handbook/onboarding/quickstart.md, image referenced as ./assets/qs-screenshot.png. Staging shows 403 when fetching from old-bucket.
alex: @devon I can rehost — do you want me to upload or should I make PR updating path to /cdn/assets/handbook/qs-screenshot.png?
devon: if you can upload, please. Then ping me and I'll open PR to swap path + small alt text tweak. Also add `alt="Onboarding flow — step 2"`.
sre-jen: FYI if you need a presigned URL here's how:
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-assets/handbook/qs-screenshot.png --expires-in 3600
devon: thanks — @alex if you upload can you add cache-control: public, max-age=31536000?
alex: uploaded to s3://redwood-cdn-staging/handbook/qs-screenshot.png and set cache headers. PR: #7842 will update markdown and alt. pinging @maria nguyen for visual check.
maria nguyen: checked on staging — looks good. tiny nit: can we resize to 900px width? otherwise lgtm.
alex: resized and force-pushed to PR. Leaving a short PR description. devon, do code review when you have a sec.
devon: reviewing now, will merge once CI passes. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
docs-bot: PR #7842 opened by alex — diff: updated image path and alt text. Link scanner will re-run on merge.
